generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the academic work you are already doing. Across your degree you will read research, lean on it in your essays, and, before long, design and carry out a study of your own. The students who get the most from a course like this treat research as something they do, not just something they read about, so treat what follows as being about your own projects and reports.

The same habit reaches well beyond study. In many kinds of work you are asked a question, gather evidence in a planned way, and reach a conclusion others can rely on. Learning to do that carefully is something you keep long after you graduate.
